description:
parse_mta_sts_policy silently accepts duplicate 'mode' fields with last-wins semantics. A policy body like 'version: STSv1
mode: enforce
mx: ...
mode: none
max_age: 86400' would be parsed as mode=none, silently downgrading enforcement. RFC 8461 §3.2 does not explicitly require rejection of duplicate fields, but since mode controls security enforcement, a duplicate mode field should be treated as a parse error (PolicyParseFailed) rather than silently accepted. The same issue applies to max_age and potentially mx (though mx accumulation is intentional). Fix: track whether mode and max_age have already been set; return PolicyParseFailed on duplicate.

## Context
mta_sts_policy.rs line 73: mode = Some(parsed) overwrites any previously parsed mode. RFC 8461 §3.2 specifies each field once.
title: mta_sts_policy: duplicate 'mode' field silently overwrites with last-wins
